question.prompt: Name a viral social media challenge or participatory trend that spread widely online.
question.criteria: A named, widely documented online challenge or trend in which people posted their own attempts, imitations, or variations.

answers.evidence: Participants dumped ice water over themselves and nominated others to participate in a fundraising challenge associated with ALS.
Participants held frozen poses while a camera moved through the scene.
Videos used a clip of Baauer's Harlem Shake to transition from a lone dancer to a group dancing chaotically.
Participants flipped a partially filled water bottle and tried to make it land upright.
Participants posted photographs of themselves lying face down with rigid bodies in unusual locations.
A dance created by Jalaiah Harmon spread widely through videos set to K Camp's Lottery.
Participants performed a dance to Ghost Town DJ's My Boo.
Participants shared a four-image grid showing different personas for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Tinder.
Paired participants used a light-switch transition to swap outfits or positions to Drake's Nonstop.
Participants used coordinated transitions to reveal changes in their appearance to Don't Rush by Young T and Bugsey.
Participants photographed themselves crouching in an owl-like pose in unusual places.
Participants staged photographs that created the illusion of a detached head beside a body.
Participants positioned record sleeves in front of their bodies to make the cover images appear to merge with the surrounding scene.
Participants performed a dance to Drake's In My Feelings popularized by Shiggy.
Users recreated Jenna Ortega's dance from the television series Wednesday.
Participants shared photographs of themselves taken roughly ten years apart.
Participants wiped a mirror to reveal a changed appearance in videos set to BMW Kenny's Wipe It Down.
Participants fashioned pillows into outfits, typically securing them with belts.
Participants recreated artworks using household objects and shared their versions online.
Participants copied a dance routine to Megan Thee Stallion's song Savage.
Participants performed a coordinated dance to The Weeknd's song Blinding Lights.

question.explanation: These trends spread through participation: people copied a dance, attempted a task, recreated an image, or added their own twist. Other answers that meet the criteria also count.

provenance.brief: Name a viral social media challenge or trend that spread widely online.

Ice Bucket Challenge.reason: Widely documented viral fundraising challenge in which participants dumped ice water over themselves and nominated others.

Mannequin Challenge.reason: Widely documented video trend featuring participants remaining motionless as a camera moved around them.

Harlem Shake.reason: Viral video format featuring a lone dancer followed by a cut to chaotic group dancing to Baauer's track.

Bottle Flip Challenge.reason: Widely shared challenge involving attempts to flip a partially filled bottle and land it upright.

Planking.reason: Widely documented photo trend involving lying face down with a rigid body in varied locations.

Renegade.reason: Jalaiah Harmon's dance to K Camp's Lottery became a widely imitated social media trend.

Running Man Challenge.reason: Widely documented dance challenge associated with Ghost Town DJ's My Boo.

Dolly Parton Challenge.reason: Viral four-image grid trend contrasting personas for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Tinder.

Flip the Switch.reason: Widely imitated video challenge using Drake's Nonstop and a light-switch transition to swap outfits or roles.

Don't Rush Challenge.reason: Viral makeover-transition challenge set to Don't Rush by Young T and Bugsey.

Owling.reason: Documented participatory photo fad involving crouching in an owl-like pose in unusual locations.

Horsemaning.reason: Documented photo meme in which participants staged the illusion of a detached head beside a body.

Sleeveface.reason: Established participatory photo trend aligning record-sleeve artwork with people's bodies and surroundings.

In My Feelings Challenge.reason: Widely documented dance challenge popularized by Shiggy using Drake's In My Feelings.

Wednesday Dance.reason: Jenna Ortega's dance from Wednesday inspired widespread online recreations and variations.

Ten Year Challenge.reason: Viral participatory trend comparing personal photographs taken approximately ten years apart.

Wipe It Down.reason: Widely documented mirror-wiping transformation trend set to BMW Kenny's Wipe It Down.

Pillow Challenge.reason: Viral fashion-photo challenge involving wearing a pillow as an outfit, commonly secured with a belt.

Getty Museum Challenge.reason: Widely documented museum-led challenge inviting people to recreate artworks with household materials.

Savage Challenge.reason: Widely imitated dance challenge set to Megan Thee Stallion's Savage.

Blinding Lights Challenge.reason: Viral group dance challenge set to The Weeknd's Blinding Lights.
